auth.art.title: Every device on the bench, on one tag.
auth.art.text: Check the device in, print its tag, stamp every step of the repair. Your customer follows it on their phone.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The action could not be completed. Refresh the page and try again; if it keeps happening, try again a little later.
home.title: Repair shop work order tracking
home.heading: Work order tracking for repair shops
home.text: For shops that repair phones, computers and small appliances: device check-in and receipt, quote approval, parts inventory, payments. Your customer follows their device on their phone.
account.denied.title: No access
account.denied.heading: You don't have access to this page
account.denied.text: Only the shop owner can open this page. If something needs to change, tell the shop owner.
account.check_email.title: Check your email
account.check_email.text: If an account was created with this address, we sent the confirmation link to your email. The link is valid for 24 hours.
account.check_email.spam_html: If it doesn't arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder or ask for a new link.
account.confirm.ok_text: Your account is ready. You can now sign in to your shop.
account.confirm.bad_text: This confirmation link has expired or was copied incompletely.
account.forgot.title: Forgot password
account.forgot.text: Enter your account's email address and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
account.forgot_sent.text: If this address has an account, we sent the password reset link. The link is valid for 1 hour and can be used only once.
account.forgot_sent.spam_html: If it doesn't arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder or try again.
account.login.title: Sign in
account.login.not_confirmed_html: Your email address isn't confirmed yet. Click the link we sent you or ask for a new link.
account.register.title: Register your shop
account.register.text: Your shop and owner account are created in one step. Then a confirmation link arrives in your email.
account.password.help: At least 10 characters, with letters and digits. A long sentence works too.
account.resend.title: New confirmation link
account.resend.text: Enter the email you registered with; if the account isn't confirmed yet, we'll send a new link.
account.reset.title: Set a new password
account.reset.text: When your password changes, all your open sessions are closed; you sign in again with the new password.
account.reset.new_link: Ask for a new reset link
account.reset_done.title: Your password was changed
account.reset_done.text: Your sessions on other devices were closed. You can sign in with your new password.
account.error.invalid_login: Wrong email or password. After 5 failed attempts in a row, sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.
account.error.shop_name: The shop name must be 2 to 100 characters.
account.error.name: The name must be 2 to 100 characters.
account.error.password_short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
account.error.password_digit: The password must contain at least one digit.
account.error.password_letter: The password must contain at least one letter.
account.error.password_repetitive: The password must contain at least 4 different characters.
account.error.password_common: This password appears very often in leaked password lists and is easy to guess. Choose another one.
account.error.reset_link: This reset link is invalid: it has expired, was already used or was copied incompletely. Ask for a new link.
account.error.generic: The action could not be completed. Check the details and try again.

list.text: Open jobs start with the one waiting longest. Search by name, phone, IMEI, work order or tracking code.
list.heading: List
list.no_match_text: Search by name, phone (like 0532 123 45 67), IMEI, work order number (2026-0042 or 42) or tracking code.
list.search_all_html: The "{0}" filter is on; search all.
list.empty_open: No open jobs on the bench
list.empty_open_text_html: When a new device comes in, press Check in a device.
list.empty_filter: No work orders in this filter
list.truncated: Showing the first {0} work orders; narrow the search or pick a filter.
intake.title: Check in a device
intake.text: Start with the customer's phone: if they are on file, their details and devices come up; if not, you add them as a new customer.
intake.new_customer: No customer on file with {0}; they will be added as a new customer.
intake.email_help: If given, the customer gets an email whenever the status changes.
intake.pick_device: Pick one of the customer's devices or add a new one.
intake.imei_help: Dial *#06# on the phone to see it.
intake.complaint_example: e.g. Cracked screen, touch not working in the bottom right
intake.condition_example: e.g. Scratch on the frame, back glass intact
intake.passcode_help: Only if the repair needs it. Deleted when the work order closes; never shown on the receipt or tracking page.
intake.promise_help: The customer sees it as the "estimated pickup" on the tracking page; you can change it later on the work order page.
intake.preview: The tag fills in as you type; saving stamps the number on it.
field.kvkk_consent: The privacy notice was read to the customer and they consented to the processing of their personal data
error.customer_name: Enter the customer's name (2 to 100 characters).
error.customer_email: Enter a valid email or leave it empty.
error.kvkk_consent: A new customer can't be saved until the privacy notice is read to them and they consent.
error.device_kind: Pick a device type from the list.
error.serial: The serial no can be at most 60 characters.
error.imei: The IMEI must be 15 digits with a matching check digit. Dial *#06# on the phone to see it; if unsure, leave it empty.
error.text_fields_too_long: Text fields can be at most 1000 characters.
error.promised_date: The pickup date must be today or within the next {0} days.
error.customer_not_found: The selected customer wasn't found. Search by phone again.
error.device_not_found: The selected device doesn't belong to this customer. Pick from the list or add a new device.
error.duplicate_phone: A customer with this phone is already on file. Search by phone again and pick that customer.
error.intake_failed: The work order couldn't be opened. Check the details and try again.
error.warranty_ended: This work order's warranty has ended or the device hasn't been picked up yet. Check it in as a new device.
error.invalid_transition: This can't be done in the work order's current status; the page has been updated.
error.cancel_reason: Enter the reason for cancelling; the customer and the history show it.
error.text_too_long: The text can be at most 1000 characters.
error.closed: A closed work order can't be changed.
error.quote_empty: Add a line to the quote before sending it.
error.decider_name: Enter the name of the person who decided.
error.insufficient_stock: There isn't enough stock for the parts on the quote. Record a stock intake first, then try again.
error.wrong_branch: This work order belongs to another branch; switch to that branch and try again.
error.balance_due: There is a balance due. Record the payment first; only the shop owner can hand over with a balance due.
error.refund_due: The customer overpaid; record the refund before handing over.
error.refund_required: Refund the payment received before cancelling.
error.owner_only: Only the shop owner can do this: refunds and handing over with a balance due.
error.invalid_amount: The amount must be greater than zero (at most two decimals).
error.overpayment: You can't take more than the balance due.
error.refund_too_large: You can't refund more than was paid.
error.payment_not_allowed: A cancelled work order can't take payments.
error.payment_note_too_long: The note can be at most 200 characters.
error.diagnosis_fee: The diagnosis fee must be zero or more, with at most two decimals.
error.line_description: Enter the line's description (at most 200 characters).
error.line_quantity: The quantity must be a number greater than zero (at most two decimals).
error.part_quantity_whole: Parts from stock are added in whole units (1, 2, 3...).
error.unit_price: Enter the unit price: zero or more, with at most two decimals.
error.vat_rate: The VAT rate must be between 0 and 100.
error.discount: The discount must be between 0 and 100.
error.quote_locked: The quote can't be changed after the customer has decided.
error.line_not_found: This line wasn't found; the page has been updated.
error.part_not_found: The selected part wasn't found or is no longer in use.
error.step_failed: That didn't work. Refresh the page and try again.
workorder.promise_saved: Pickup date saved; it shows on the tracking page.
workorder.created: Work order {0} is open. Print the receipt for the customer and stick the label on the device; the tracking code is on the receipt.
workorder.warranty_of_html: Came back under warranty. Previous work order: {1}
workorder.allow_balance: Hand over with a balance due (owner's approval)
workorder.cancel_example: e.g. The customer changed their mind about the repair
workorder.promise_label: Pickup date promised to the customer
workorder.whatsapp_help: A message with the status and tracking link is prefilled; you can edit it before sending.
workorder.passcode_kept: Device passcode on file; deleted when the work order closes.
workorder.workshop_note_example: e.g. Logic board is damp, left to dry
quote.title: Quote
quote.locked: Waiting for the customer's approval; the quote is locked.
quote.after_diagnosis: The quote is prepared once diagnosis starts.
quote.none: This work order has no quote.
quote.no_parts: This branch has no parts in stock yet. You can add a part that isn't in stock as an "ordered part" with the form next to this one.
quote.warranty_free: Under warranty: labour is suggested free of charge.
payment.title: Payments
payment.refund_note_example: e.g. Deposit for the cancelled job
warranty.title: New check-in under warranty
warranty.from_previous: The customer and device come from the previous work order.
warranty.linked: The new work order is linked to the previous one; the quote suggests free labour.
warranty.complaint_example: e.g. Touch still not working on the replaced screen
label.title: Device label {0}

receipt.title: Check-in receipt {0}
receipt.name: Check-in receipt
receipt.hint: A5 paper, portrait. Print two copies: one for the customer, one for the shop.
receipt.passcode: Device passcode taken; deleted when the work order closes.
receipt.qr: QR code for the tracking page
receipt.track_text: Scan the QR code with your phone or open the address. You also approve the quote on this page.
receipt.term_quote: No repair starts before the quote is approved. If the amount changes during the repair, approval is asked again.
receipt.term_warranty: Replaced parts and labour are under warranty for {0} days from pickup. Liquid contact, drops and opening elsewhere are not covered.
receipt.term_no_warranty: This shop gives no separate warranty for repairs.
receipt.term_data: Backing up the data on the device is the customer's responsibility; data may be lost during the repair.
receipt.term_pickup: Show this receipt or the tracking code when picking up the device.

inventory.no_low: No parts are at their critical level.
inventory.empty: No parts yet. Add the first one below.
inventory.critical_help: Shows as low on stock when it drops to this number. 0: no alert.
inventory.no_movements: No movements yet. They show up here once you receive stock.
inventory.adjusted: Stock corrected to {0} after the count.
inventory.reactivated: The part is back in use.
inventory.retired: The part was retired; its past records stay.

error.price: Prices must be zero or more, with at most two decimals.

error.adjust_reason: Enter the reason for the correction (e.g. Count difference, Broken).
error.duplicate_sku: A part with this code already exists.

error.action_failed: That didn't work. Check the details and try again.

staff.name: Name
staff.remove_confirm: Remove {0} from the shop? Their account is deleted; their name stays in work order history.
staff.invite_text: The invitation link goes by email; it's valid for 7 days and works once.
staff.invited: Invitation sent to {0}. The link is valid for 7 days and works once.
staff.revoked: Invitation revoked; the link no longer works.
staff.removed: Staff member removed; their account was deleted and signed out.
invitation.title: Accept the invitation
invitation.heading: {0} invited you
invitation.text_html: You're joining as a technician with {0}. Choose your name and password; your account opens right away.
invitation.invalid_text: This link may have expired, been used already, or been revoked by the shop owner. Ask the shop owner for a new invitation.
invitation.invalid_login_html: If your account is already open, sign in.
invitation.error.email_taken: This email address already has a Tamirhane account. An account works at one shop only; to join this shop, ask the owner to invite another address.
settings.text: Shop name, warranty period, default VAT and branches.
settings.warranty_help: Counted from pickup. 0 means no warranty.
settings.vat_help: Suggested rate for new quote lines; can be changed per line.
settings.branches_note: With a single branch, branch selection doesn't appear anywhere.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Warranty and VAT apply to new work orders and new quote lines.
settings.branch_added: Branch {0} added. Switch to it with the branch picker in the menu.
tracking.private: This page is just for you. Share the link only with the person picking up the device.
tracking.missing_heading: We couldn't find this tracking code
tracking.missing_text: Open the link again by scanning the QR code on your receipt or from the message you got. The code is 12 characters and printed at the bottom of the receipt; if it still doesn't work, call the shop where you left the device.
tracking.lead.received: Your device is at the shop. It will be looked at when its turn comes.
tracking.lead.diagnosing: Your device is being diagnosed. Once we find the fault, we'll get in touch about the price.
tracking.lead.awaiting_approval: The quote is ready and waiting for your approval. You can also call the shop to approve or ask questions.
tracking.lead.ready: Your device is ready. Bring your receipt and pick it up.
tracking.lead.declined: The repair won't be done. You can come and pick up your device.
tracking.lead.delivered: Your device has been picked up.
tracking.lead.cancelled: This work order was cancelled. If something's wrong, call the shop.
tracking.push.title: Get notified
tracking.push.text: We'll send a notification to this browser when the status changes; no need to keep the page open.
tracking.push.subscribe: Notify me when the status changes
tracking.push.active: We're notifying this browser. You'll get a notification when the status changes.
tracking.push.on: Done, we'll let you know when the status changes.
tracking.push.off: No more notifications for this work order.
tracking.push.denied: Notification permission wasn't given. You can turn it on in the browser's site settings.
tracking.push.on_failed: Couldn't turn it on right now; could you try again in a moment?
tracking.push.off_failed: Couldn't turn it off right now; could you try again in a moment?
tracking.decided_by_help: The name of who decided is recorded on the work order. The decision can be made once.
tracking.decision.name_required: Enter your full name so we can record who decided (at most 100 characters).
tracking.decision.approved: Your approval was sent to the shop. You'll see it on this page when the repair starts.
tracking.decision.declined: Your decision was sent to the shop. You can call the shop to arrange picking up your device.
tracking.decision.already: A decision was already made on this quote; the latest status on the page is what counts.
error.demo_no_invite: The demo shop sends no email, so invitations can't be sent. In your real shop you invite technicians by email.
demo.try_help: The demo opens a workshop of your own, filled with sample work orders and stock. No sign-up needed; it's deleted after 24 hours.
demo.login_text: No account? Try every screen in your own demo workshop with sample data.
demo.strip: This is a demo workshop: try anything with the sample data. No email is sent and the workshop is deleted after {0} hours.
demo.full: Too many demos are open right now; try again a little later or open your own shop now.
